understanding: Implement a standalone GeminiVlmProvider class in src/oko/providers/gemini_vlm.py that inherits from VlmProvider, integrates with Google Gemini API (gemini-2.5-flash model), handles text+image inputs, parses responses, manages API keys via env var with secrets.json fallback, and is fully testable offline via transport injection. Must not modify VlmGate/event architecture or integrate into pipeline. Tests must be deterministic and network-free.
summary: Create GeminiVlmProvider with name='gemini', default model='gemini-2.5-flash', injectable transport, API key resolution from GEMINI_API_KEY env var or ~/.bridge-private/secrets.json (geminiApiKey field), POST to Gemini generateContent endpoint with x-goog-api-key header, parse candidates[0].content.parts[].text into VlmResponse, raise RuntimeError on missing key or empty response text. Include offline tests verifying endpoint/model/headers/timeout, image handling (b64 and path), key errors, and malformed JSON handling.

decision_atoms.statement: Use transport injection pattern from http_vlm.py for offline testing
decision_atoms.reason: Allows deterministic tests without network by injecting a mock transport that returns predefined responses
decision_atoms.tradeoff: Adds one parameter to __init__ but maintains consistency with existing codebase patterns

decision_atoms.statement: Implement two-stage API key resolution: os.environ[api_key_env] first, then ~/.bridge-private/secrets.json fallback
decision_atoms.reason: Matches slopvid google_auth pattern; env var is standard for production, secrets.json provides developer convenience
decision_atoms.tradeoff: File I/O on every query if env var missing; acceptable for key lookup frequency

decision_atoms.statement: Raise RuntimeError with variable name when no API key found
decision_atoms.reason: Constraint requires honest error with variable name, not empty text; aids debugging
decision_atoms.tradeoff: Slightly more verbose error handling but provides clear failure reason

decision_atoms.statement: Raise RuntimeError in _extract_gemini_text on empty/missing text instead of returning empty string
decision_atoms.reason: Explicit constraint; prevents silent failures downstream when Gemini returns no content
decision_atoms.tradeoff: Callers must handle RuntimeError; stricter than returning empty string but safer

decision_atoms.statement: Default model strictly gemini-2.5-flash, not pro or 3-flash
decision_atoms.reason: Explicit constraint in task; gemini-2.5-flash is the specified model for this chapter
decision_atoms.tradeoff: Less capable than pro models but faster/cheaper; appropriate for VLM tasks in this context

decision_atoms.reason: Matches Gemini API response structure; extracts generated text from first candidate
decision_atoms.tradeoff: Assumes single candidate and text part; sufficient for current use case, may need extension for multi-turn

decision_atoms.statement: Support both image_b64 and image_path in request, with _gemini_inline_image helper
decision_atoms.reason: Flexibility for callers; image_path auto-converts to base64 inline_data format
decision_atoms.tradeoff: Adds file I/O for image_path; acceptable for VLM provider responsibilities

assumptions: VlmProvider base class exists with expected interface (query method signature, name attribute)
VlmResponse dataclass/class exists with fields: text, provider, model, latency_ms
http_vlm.py transport pattern uses a callable/object with a request method matching requests.Session interface
~/.bridge-private/secrets.json is valid JSON with optional geminiApiKey field
Gemini API endpoint and response structure remain stable as documented
Image mime_type can be inferred or defaults to 'image/png' when reading from path
Tests will use a mock transport that returns controlled responses
No concurrent access concerns for secrets.json file reading

risks.risk: Gemini API response structure changes (e.g., candidates array format)
risks.mitigation: Isolate response parsing in _extract_gemini_text helper; add defensive checks for response structure; tests cover malformed JSON

risks.risk: secrets.json file missing or malformed causes unexpected errors
risks.mitigation: Catch JSON decode errors and file not found; raise clear RuntimeError; tests cover missing file scenario

risks.risk: Large image base64 encoding causes memory pressure
risks.mitigation: Document image size expectations; streaming/chunked encoding can be added later if needed

risks.risk: Timeout handling inconsistent with transport injection
risks.mitigation: Pass timeout parameter to transport; tests verify timeout is propagated; document transport interface expectations

risks.risk: API key exposed in logs if error messages include it
risks.mitigation: Ensure RuntimeError messages reference variable name, not key value; sanitize any debug logging

minimal_version: Implement GeminiVlmProvider with __init__, query, _gemini_inline_image, _extract_gemini_text, and _get_api_key methods. Support text-only and text+image requests. API key from env or secrets.json. Basic error handling. Offline tests with mock transport covering success path, missing key, empty response.
advanced_version: Add support for multiple images, response streaming, automatic mime_type detection from image_path, configurable API endpoint, retry logic with exponential backoff, structured logging, and integration test suite with recorded HTTP cassettes.
